title: When the Cheapest Feasible Router Fails: Auditing Deployment Commitments in Cost-Aware LLM Routing
abstract: arXiv:2611.20417v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Cost-aware LLM routing often selects the cheapest policy meeting empirical risk and coverage constraints. Yet a router that passes an audit can violate its fixed service contract on new requests, even when candidate policies are constructed independently. We study this deployment-commitment decision with disjoint construction, audit, and test samples. Across 19 RouterBench task families, the cheapest audit-feasible router deploys in 91.82% of opportunities but violates the held-out contract in 32.22% of deployments. We introduce Menu-Aware Routing Commitment (MARC), which qualifies policies using audit evidence and a serving-cost tolerance to retain the apparent winner, deploy a supported alternative, or defer. Its practical policywise variant (MARC-P) reduces observed conditional failure to 0.73% at 85.79% deployment, with higher serving cost; fixed-margin and formal risk-control procedures provide competitive alternatives. translated_title: 当最便宜可行路由器失效时：成本感知LLM路由中的部署承诺审计
translated_abstract: 成本感知的LLM路由通常选择满足经验风险和覆盖约束的最便宜策略。然而，即使候选策略是独立构建的，通过审计的路由器在新请求上仍可能违反其固定的服务契约。我们在构建、审计和测试样本互不相交的条件下研究这一部署承诺决策问题。在19个RouterBench任务族上的实验表明，最便宜的通过审计可行的路由器在91.82%的机会中被部署，但在32.22%的部署中违反了留出契约。我们提出了菜单感知路由承诺（MARC），它利用审计证据和服务成本容差对策略进行资格认证，以保留表面上最优的方案、部署有依据的替代方案或推迟部署。其实用的逐策略变体（MARC-P）在85.79%的部署率下将观察到的条件失败率降至0.73%，但服务成本更高；固定边际和形式化风险控制程序则提供了具有竞争力的替代方案。
tldr: 提出MARC框架，通过审计证据与服务成本容差对候选路由策略进行资格认证，将成本感知LLM路由部署后的条件契约失败率从32.22%大幅降至0.73%。
en_tdlr: MARC qualifies candidate routing policies using audit evidence and a serving-cost tolerance, reducing post-deployment conditional contract failures in cost-aware LLM routing from 32.22% to 0.73%.
